The '''Kubaza beetle cavern''' was a cavernous complex dug out by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] into the side of the [[Central volcano/Legends|central volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was abandoned after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it had become the home of a colony of [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|Kubaza beetles]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] tricked a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] into setting up several amplification markers within the cavern so that he could transfer his [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] from the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|he was trapped in]] to the dormant [[Neimoidian droid factory]] on the planet, in an attempt to reactivate it and subjugate the "meatbags" on Mustafar. The droid's plans were eventually halted by these same spacers when they destroyed the droid's new frame after a fierce battle within a [[Magma/Legends|lava]] crater.

==Behind the scenes==
The Kubaza beetle cavern appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
